blocking_finding.retry_mechanism: Points that the batch solver leaves empty are recomputed as single-temperature equilibria (no warm start), bounded to 8 retries, and the retries are recorded. At 875 degC the retry did not converge either.
flakiness_evidence: Across separate processes the B-DQ scan produced 0, 1, 2 or 3 non-converged points for the identical request.
A standalone single-temperature call at 850-1000 degC converged in every case, so the failure is tied to the batch solver's warm-start path, not to the thermodynamics.
Changing pdens (500/1000/2000/4000/8000) did not remove the failure.
blocking_finding.not_a_round_off_issue: This is a genuine solver failure (a point returns no stable phase at all), not the ~1e-10 run-to-run drift that R-DQ shows.

critical_defect_found_and_fixed.summary: The component list sent to pycalphad omitted the vacancy species VA. pycalphad does not raise for this: it returns a physically wrong assemblage whose phase fractions still sum to 1.
critical_defect_found_and_fixed.observed_without_va: For the B-DQ reduced system the 400 degC point returned LIQUID 0.97 with a phase-fraction sum of 0.99942, i.e. a solid low-alloy steel reported as 97 % liquid, and the sum check alone did not catch it.
critical_defect_found_and_fixed.observed_with_va: The same point returns BCC_A2 0.9685 + CEMENTITE 0.0277 + FCC_A1 0.0032, and the sequence is ferrite + cementite -> ferrite + austenite -> austenite -> delta ferrite + liquid -> liquid, which is the expected behaviour.
critical_defect_found_and_fixed.fix: The isolated worker always adds VA to the pycalphad component list when the database declares it, and reports pycalphad_components in the result record.
critical_defect_found_and_fixed.guard_added: The phase-4 validation now applies a physical plausibility check (no liquid below 1000 degC, liquid above 1500 degC, a BCC_A2/FCC_A1 matrix below 700 degC) because a phase-fraction-sum check cannot see this class of error.
